crossRefs.note: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against…
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

translations.web: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
translations.bsb: Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
translations.kjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
translations.asv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.
